lines: Five-day history of intermittent high fever, shaking chills, and drenching sweats following recent return from camping trip in rural Uganda.

He recently returned from a 3-week trip to rural Uganda, where he participated in outdoor camping.
Two days after returning, he began experiencing intermittent high fevers accompanied by shaking chills and followed by profuse sweating, leaving him exhausted.
He also reports headaches, myalgias, and generalized malaise.
He did not take any malaria prophylaxis during his trip.
